question: What is the name of the player with the highest earnings?
original: SELECT Name FROM player ORDER BY Earnings DESC LIMIT 1
fixed: SELECT p.name FROM player p WHERE p.earnings = (SELECT MAX(earnings) FROM player);

question: Return the name of the player who earns the most money.
original: SELECT Name FROM player ORDER BY Earnings DESC LIMIT 1
fixed: SELECT P.name FROM player P WHERE P.earnings = (SELECT MAX(earnings) FROM player)

question: What is the country of the player with the highest earnings among players that have more than 2 win counts?
original: SELECT Country FROM player WHERE Wins_count  >  2 ORDER BY Earnings DESC LIMIT 1
fixed: SELECT p.country FROM player p WHERE p.wins_count > 2 and p.earnings = (SELECT MAX(earnings) FROM player WHERE wins_count>2)

question: Of players who have more than 2 wins, what is the country of the player who makes the most?
original: SELECT Country FROM player WHERE Wins_count  >  2 ORDER BY Earnings DESC LIMIT 1
fixed: SELECT p.country FROM player p WHERE p.wins_count > 2 and p.earnings = (SELECT MAX(earnings) FROM player WHERE wins_count>2)

question: Show names of clubs that have players with more than 2 win counts.
original: SELECT T1.Name FROM club AS T1 JOIN player AS T2 ON T1.Club_ID  =  T2.Club_ID WHERE T2.Wins_count  >  2
fixed: SELECT name FROM club WHERE club_id IN (SELECT club_id FROM player WHERE wins_count > 2)

question: What are the names of clubs that have players who have won more than twice?
original: SELECT T1.Name FROM club AS T1 JOIN player AS T2 ON T1.Club_ID  =  T2.Club_ID WHERE T2.Wins_count  >  2
fixed: SELECT name FROM club WHERE club_id IN (SELECT club_id FROM player WHERE wins_count > 2)

question: Please show the most common manufacturer of clubs.
original: SELECT Manufacturer FROM club GROUP BY Manufacturer ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1
fixed: SELECT manufacturer FROM club GROUP BY manufacturer HAVING COUNT(*) = (SELECT MAX(cnt) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) as cnt FROM club GROUP BY manufacturer))

question: Which manufacturer is most common among clubs?
original: SELECT Manufacturer FROM club GROUP BY Manufacturer ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1
fixed: SELECT manufacturer FROM club GROUP BY manufacturer HAVING COUNT(*) = (SELECT MAX(cnt) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) as cnt FROM club GROUP BY manufacturer))

question: Show the country of players with earnings more than 1400000 and players with earnings less than 1100000.
original: SELECT Country FROM player WHERE Earnings  >  1400000 INTERSECT SELECT Country FROM player WHERE Earnings  <  1100000
fixed: SELECT DISTINCT country FROM player WHERE earnings > 1400000 UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT country FROM player WHERE earnings < 1100000

question: For every order, how many products does it contain, and what are the orders' statuses and ids?
original: SELECT T1.order_id ,  T1.order_status_code ,  count(*) FROM Orders AS T1 JOIN Order_items AS T2 ON T1.order_id  =  T2.order_id GROUP BY T1.order_id
fixed: SELECT order_id, order_status_code, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM order_items WHERE order_items.order_id = orders.order_id) AS product_count FROM orders

question: Which customers did not make any orders? List the first name, middle initial and last name.
original: SELECT customer_first_name ,  customer_middle_initial ,  customer_last_name FROM Customers EXCEPT SELECT T1.customer_first_name ,  T1.customer_middle_initial ,  T1.customer_last_name FROM Customers AS T1 JOIN Orders AS T2 ON T1.customer_id  =  T2.customer_id
fixed: SELECT customer_first_name, customer_middle_initial, customer_last_name FROM customers WHERE customer_id NOT IN (SELECT customer_id FROM orders)

question: WHat are the first and last names, and middle initials of all customers who did not make any orders?
original: SELECT customer_first_name ,  customer_middle_initial ,  customer_last_name FROM Customers EXCEPT SELECT T1.customer_first_name ,  T1.customer_middle_initial ,  T1.customer_last_name FROM Customers AS T1 JOIN Orders AS T2 ON T1.customer_id  =  T2.customer_id
fixed: SELECT c.customer_first_name, c.customer_last_name, c.customer_middle_initial FROM customers c WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM orders o WHERE o.customer_id = c.customer_id)

question: What are the ids , names , prices , and colors of all products that have been listed in less than two orders ?
original: select t1.product_id ,  t1.product_name ,  t1.product_price ,  t1.product_color from products as t1 join order_items as t2 on t1.product_id  =  t2.product_id join orders as t3 on t2.order_id  =  t3.order_id group by t1.product_id having count(*) < 2
fixed: SELECT p.product_id, p.product_name, p.product_price, p.product_color FROM products p WHERE (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT oi.order_id) FROM order_items oi WHERE oi.product_id = p.product_id) < 2

question: Which product are listed in orders most frequently? List the id, product name and price.
original: SELECT T1.product_id ,  T1.product_name ,  T1.product_price FROM Products AS T1 JOIN Order_items AS T2 ON T1.product_id  =  T2.product_id GROUP BY T1.product_id ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1
fixed: WITH RankedProducts AS (SELECT P.product_id, P.product_name, P.product_price, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(OI.product_id) DESC) as Rank FROM products P JOIN order_items OI ON P.product_id = OI.product_id GROUP BY P.product_id) SELECT product_id, product_name, product_price FROM RankedProducts WHERE Rank = 1;

question: What are the ids, names, and prices of all products that are ordered most frequently?
original: SELECT T1.product_id ,  T1.product_name ,  T1.product_price FROM Products AS T1 JOIN Order_items AS T2 ON T1.product_id  =  T2.product_id GROUP BY T1.product_id ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1
fixed: SELECT product_id, product_name, product_price FROM (SELECT T1.product_id, T1.product_name, T1.product_price, rank() over (ORDER BY count(*) DESC) as rk FROM Products AS T1 JOIN Order_items AS T2 ON T1.product_id = T2.product_id GROUP BY T1.product_id) WHERE rk = 1;

question: Which order have the least sum of the product prices. List the order id and sum.
original: SELECT T1.order_id ,  sum(T2.product_price) FROM Order_items AS T1 JOIN Products AS T2 ON T1.product_id  =  T2.product_id GROUP BY T1.order_id ORDER BY sum(T2.product_price) ASC LIMIT 1
fixed: SELECT order_id, sum_price FROM (SELECT T1.order_id, sum(T2.product_price) as sum_price, rank() over (ORDER BY sum(T2.product_price) ) as rk FROM Order_items AS T1 JOIN Products AS T2 ON T1.product_id = T2.product_id GROUP BY T1.order_id) WHERE rk = 1;

question: What is the order that total cost the least , and how much is the total cost ?
original: select t1.order_id ,  sum(t2.product_price) from order_items as t1 join products as t2 on t1.product_id  =  t2.product_id group by t1.order_id order by sum(t2.product_price) asc limit 1
fixed: SELECT order_id, sum_price FROM (SELECT T1.order_id, sum(T2.product_price) as sum_price, rank() over (ORDER BY sum(T2.product_price) ) as rk FROM Order_items AS T1 JOIN Products AS T2 ON T1.product_id = T2.product_id GROUP BY T1.order_id) WHERE rk = 1;

question: What is the most popular payment method?
original: SELECT Payment_method_code FROM Customer_Payment_Methods GROUP BY Payment_method_code ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1
fixed: SELECT payment_method_code FROM (SELECT payment_method_code, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) as rank FROM customer_payment_methods GROUP BY payment_method_code) WHERE rank = 1

question: What is the payment method that most customers use?
original: SELECT Payment_method_code FROM Customer_Payment_Methods GROUP BY Payment_method_code ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1
fixed: SELECT payment_method_code FROM customer_payment_methods GROUP BY payment_method_code HAVING COUNT(*) = (SELECT max(count_global.use_count) FROM (SELECT payment_method_code, COUNT(*) AS use_count FROM customer_payment_methods GROUP BY payment_method_code) count_global)

question: How many number of products does each gender of customers buy? List the gender and the number
original: SELECT T1.gender_code ,  count(*) FROM Customers AS T1 JOIN Orders AS T2 ON T1.customer_id  =  T2.customer_id JOIN Order_items AS T3 ON T2.order_id  =  T3.order_id GROUP BY T1.gender_code
fixed: SELECT g.gender_code, COUNT(*) AS total_products FROM customers g LEFT JOIN orders o ON g.customer_id = o.customer_id LEFT JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id GROUP BY g.gender_code;

question: How many products does each gender buy?
original: SELECT T1.gender_code ,  count(*) FROM Customers AS T1 JOIN Orders AS T2 ON T1.customer_id  =  T2.customer_id JOIN Order_items AS T3 ON T2.order_id  =  T3.order_id GROUP BY T1.gender_code
fixed: SELECT g.gender_code, COUNT(*) AS total_products FROM customers g LEFT JOIN orders o ON g.customer_id = o.customer_id LEFT JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id GROUP BY g.gender_code;

question: How many orders has each gender of customers placed?
original: SELECT T1.gender_code ,  count(*) FROM Customers AS T1 JOIN Orders AS T2 ON T1.customer_id  =  T2.customer_id GROUP BY T1.gender_code
fixed: SELECT c.gender_code, COUNT(o.order_id) FROM customers c LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id GROUP BY c.gender_code

question: How many orders has each gender placed?
original: SELECT T1.gender_code ,  count(*) FROM Customers AS T1 JOIN Orders AS T2 ON T1.customer_id  =  T2.customer_id GROUP BY T1.gender_code
fixed: SELECT g.gender_code, COUNT(*) AS total_products FROM customers g LEFT JOIN orders o ON g.customer_id = o.customer_id LEFT JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id GROUP BY g.gender_code;

question: List the customers' first name, middle initial, last name and payment methods.
original: SELECT T1.customer_first_name ,  T1.customer_middle_initial ,  T1.customer_last_name ,  T2.Payment_method_code FROM Customers AS T1 JOIN Customer_Payment_Methods AS T2 ON T1.customer_id  =  T2.customer_id
fixed: SELECT first_name, middle_initial, last_name, method_code FROM (SELECT customer_first_name AS first_name, customer_middle_initial AS middle_initial, customer_last_name AS last_name, customer_id FROM customers) AS cust LEFT JOIN (SELECT payment_method_code AS method_code, customer_id FROM customer_payment_methods) AS paym ON cust.customer_id = paym.customer_id

question: What are the first names, middle initials, last names, and payment methods of all customers?
original: SELECT T1.customer_first_name ,  T1.customer_middle_initial ,  T1.customer_last_name ,  T2.Payment_method_code FROM Customers AS T1 JOIN Customer_Payment_Methods AS T2 ON T1.customer_id  =  T2.customer_id
fixed: SELECT c1.customer_first_name, c1.customer_middle_initial, c1.customer_last_name, cp.payment_method_code FROM customers c1 LEFT JOIN customer_payment_methods cp ON c1.customer_id = cp.customer_id

question: List the invoices' status, date and the date of shipment.
original: SELECT T1.invoice_status_code ,  T1.invoice_date ,  T2.shipment_date FROM Invoices AS T1 JOIN Shipments AS T2 ON T1.invoice_number  =  T2.invoice_number
fixed: SELECT T2.invoice_status_code, T2.invoice_date, T1.shipment_date FROM Shipments AS T1 LEFT JOIN Invoices AS T2 ON T1.invoice_number = T2.invoice_number

question: What are the statuses, dates, and shipment dates for all invoices?
original: SELECT T1.invoice_status_code ,  T1.invoice_date ,  T2.shipment_date FROM Invoices AS T1 JOIN Shipments AS T2 ON T1.invoice_number  =  T2.invoice_number
fixed: SELECT A.invoice_status_code, A.invoice_date, B.shipment_date FROM (SELECT invoice_number, invoice_status_code, invoice_date FROM invoices) A LEFT JOIN shipments B ON A.invoice_number = B.invoice_number

question: What is the product name and the color of the ordered items which have been shipped?
original: SELECT T1.product_name ,  T1.product_color FROM Products AS T1 JOIN Order_items AS T2 ON T1.product_id  =  T2.product_id JOIN Shipment_Items AS T3 ON T2.order_item_id  =  T3.order_item_id JOIN Shipments AS T4 ON T3.shipment_id  =  T4.shipment_id
fixed: SELECT product_name, product_color FROM products WHERE product_id IN (SELECT product_id FROM order_items WHERE order_item_id IN (SELECT order_item_id FROM shipment_items))

question: What are the names and colors of all products that have been shipped?
original: SELECT T1.product_name ,  T1.product_color FROM Products AS T1 JOIN Order_items AS T2 ON T1.product_id  =  T2.product_id JOIN Shipment_Items AS T3 ON T2.order_item_id  =  T3.order_item_id JOIN Shipments AS T4 ON T3.shipment_id  =  T4.shipment_id
fixed: SELECT product_name, product_color FROM products WHERE product_id IN (SELECT product_id FROM order_items WHERE order_item_id IN (SELECT order_item_id FROM shipment_items))

question: List all the pairs of buyer first names and product names.
original: SELECT T1.customer_first_name ,  T4.product_name FROM Customers AS T1 JOIN Orders AS T2 ON T1.customer_id  =  T2.customer_id JOIN Order_items AS T3 ON T2.order_id  =  T3.order_id JOIN Products AS T4 ON T3.product_id  =  T4.product_id
fixed: SELECT c.customer_first_name AS buyer, p.product_name AS product FROM customers c CROSS JOIN products p WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id WHERE o.customer_id = c.customer_id AND oi.product_id = p.product_id)

question: What are the first names of all buyers and what products did they buy? List them in pairs.
original: SELECT T1.customer_first_name ,  T4.product_name FROM Customers AS T1 JOIN Orders AS T2 ON T1.customer_id  =  T2.customer_id JOIN Order_items AS T3 ON T2.order_id  =  T3.order_id JOIN Products AS T4 ON T3.product_id  =  T4.product_id
fixed: SELECT c.customer_first_name AS buyer, p.product_name AS product FROM customers c CROSS JOIN products p WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id WHERE o.customer_id = c.customer_id AND oi.product_id = p.product_id)

question: How many products have been shipped?
original: SELECT count(*) FROM Shipment_Items
fixed: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT products.product_id) FROM products JOIN order_items ON products.product_id = order_items.product_id JOIN shipment_items ON order_items.order_item_id = shipment_items.order_item_id

question: What is the average price of the products being ordered?
original: SELECT avg(T1.product_price) FROM Products AS T1 JOIN Order_items AS T2 ON T1.product_id  =  T2.product_id
fixed: SELECT AVG(product_price) FROM products p JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT product_id FROM order_items) pi ON p.product_id = pi.product_id

question: What is the price of all products being ordered on average?
original: SELECT avg(T1.product_price) FROM Products AS T1 JOIN Order_items AS T2 ON T1.product_id  =  T2.product_id
fixed: SELECT AVG(product_price) FROM products WHERE product_id IN (SELECT product_id FROM order_items)

question: What are the email address, town and county of the customers who are of the least common gender?
original: SELECT email_address ,  town_city ,  county FROM Customers WHERE gender_code  =  ( SELECT gender_code FROM Customers GROUP BY gender_code ORDER BY count(*) ASC LIMIT 1 )
fixed: SELECT email_address, town_city, county FROM customers WHERE customers.gender_code IN (SELECT gender_code FROM customers GROUP BY gender_code HAVING count(*) = (SELECT count(*) AS c FROM customers GROUP BY gender_code ORDER BY c limit 1))

question: What are the email addresses, cities, and counties listed for all cusomters who are from the gender that orders less often?
original: SELECT email_address ,  town_city ,  county FROM Customers WHERE gender_code  =  ( SELECT gender_code FROM Customers GROUP BY gender_code ORDER BY count(*) ASC LIMIT 1 )
fixed: SELECT email_address, town_city, county FROM customers WHERE customers.gender_code IN (SELECT gender_code FROM customers GROUP BY gender_code HAVING count(*) = (SELECT count(*) AS c FROM customers GROUP BY gender_code ORDER BY c limit 1))

question: What is the most uncommon order status?
original: SELECT order_status_code FROM Orders GROUP BY order_status_code ORDER BY count(*) LIMIT 1
fixed: SELECT order_status_code FROM orders GROUP BY order_status_code HAVING COUNT(order_status_code) = (SELECT MIN(count) FROM (SELECT COUNT(order_status_code) as count FROM orders GROUP BY order_status_code))

question: What is the least common order status?
original: SELECT order_status_code FROM Orders GROUP BY order_status_code ORDER BY count(*) LIMIT 1
fixed: WITH OrderStatusCount AS (SELECT order_status_code, COUNT(*) AS OSCOUNT FROM orders GROUP BY order_status_code) SELECT order_status_code FROM OrderStatusCount WHERE OSCOUNT = (SELECT MIN(OSCOUNT) FROM OrderStatusCount)

question: Find the the name of the oldest director.
original: SELECT name FROM director ORDER BY age DESC LIMIT 1
fixed: SELECT name FROM director WHERE Age = (SELECT max(Age) From director)

question: Which director is in charge of the most programs?
original: SELECT t2.name FROM program AS t1 JOIN director AS t2 ON t1.director_id  =  t2.director_id GROUP BY t1.director_id ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1
fixed: SELECT name FROM director WHERE director_id in (SELECT director_id FROM program GROUP BY director_id HAVING COUNT(program_id) = (SELECT MAX(count_programs) FROM (SELECT COUNT(program_id) AS count_programs FROM program GROUP BY director_id)));

question: Find the name and age of the director who is in charge of the most programs?
original: SELECT t2.name ,  t2.age FROM program AS t1 JOIN director AS t2 ON t1.director_id  =  t2.director_id GROUP BY t1.director_id ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1
fixed: SELECT name, age FROM director WHERE director_id IN (SELECT director_id FROM program GROUP BY director_id HAVING COUNT(program_id) = (SELECT MAX(cnt) FROM (SELECT COUNT(program_id) AS cnt FROM program GROUP BY director_id)))

question: Return the title of the program that began most recently.
original: SELECT title FROM program ORDER BY start_year DESC LIMIT 1
fixed: SELECT title FROM program WHERE start_year = (SELECT MAX(start_year) FROM program);

question: Find the number of programs for each channel. Return the name of each channel as well.
original: SELECT t1.name ,  count(*) FROM channel AS t1 JOIN program AS t2 ON t1.channel_id  =  t2.channel_id GROUP BY t1.channel_id
fixed: SELECT c.name, COUNT(p.program_id) AS program_count FROM channel AS c LEFT JOIN program AS p ON c.channel_id = p.channel_id GROUP BY c.channel_id

question: What is the name of the director who is in the "Dracula" program?
original: SELECT t2.name FROM program AS t1 JOIN director AS t2 ON t1.director_id  =  t2.director_id WHERE t1.title  =  'Dracula'
fixed: SELECT name FROM director WHERE director_id IN (SELECT director_id FROM program WHERE title = 'Dracula')

question: Find the name and internet web of the channel that is directed by the most directors.
original: SELECT t1.name ,  t1.internet FROM channel AS t1 JOIN director_admin AS t2 ON t1.channel_id  =  t2.channel_id GROUP BY t1.channel_id ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1
fixed: SELECT c.name, c.internet FROM channel c INNER JOIN (SELECT channel_id FROM director_admin GROUP BY channel_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT director_id) = (SELECT MAX(num_directors) FROM (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT director_id) AS num_directors FROM director_admin GROUP BY channel_id))) da ON c.channel_id = da.channel_id

question: give me the name of channels that have both a director younger than 40 and a director older than 60.
original: SELECT t1.name FROM channel AS t1 JOIN director_admin AS t2 ON t1.channel_id  =  t2.channel_id JOIN director AS t3 ON t2.director_id  =  t3.director_id WHERE t3.age  <  40 INTERSECT SELECT t1.name FROM channel AS t1 JOIN director_admin AS t2 ON t1.channel_id  =  t2.channel_id JOIN director AS t3 ON t2.director_id  =  t3.director_id WHERE t3.age  >  60
fixed: SELECT t1.name FROM channel AS t1 JOIN director_admin AS t2 ON t1.channel_id = t2.channel_id JOIN director AS t3 ON t2.director_id = t3.director_id WHERE t3.age < 40 INTERSECT SELECT t1.name FROM channel AS t1 JOIN director_admin AS t2 ON t1.channel_id = t2.channel_id JOIN director AS t3 ON t2.director_id = t3.director_id WHERE t3.age > 60

question: Find the id and name of the channel that is not directed by Hank Baskett.
original: SELECT t1.name ,  t1.channel_id FROM channel AS t1 JOIN director_admin AS t2 ON t1.channel_id  =  t2.channel_id JOIN director AS t3 ON t2.director_id  =  t3.director_id WHERE t3.name != "Hank Baskett"
fixed: SELECT ch.channel_id, ch.name FROM channel ch WHERE ch.channel_id NOT IN (SELECT da.channel_id FROM director_admin da JOIN director d ON da.director_id = d.director_id WHERE d.name = 'Hank Baskett')

question: What is the transmitter of the radio with the largest ERP_kW?
original: SELECT Transmitter FROM radio ORDER BY ERP_kW DESC LIMIT 1
fixed: SELECT transmitter FROM radio WHERE erp_kw = (SELECT MAX(erp_kw) FROM radio)

question: Please show the most common affiliation for city channels.
original: SELECT Affiliation FROM city_channel GROUP BY Affiliation ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1
fixed: SELECT affiliation FROM city_channel GROUP BY affiliation HAVING COUNT(*) = (SELECT MAX(AffiliationCount) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS AffiliationCount FROM city_channel GROUP BY affiliation))

question: Show the transmitters of the radios and the number of city channels they are associated with.
original: SELECT T2.Transmitter ,  COUNT(*) FROM city_channel_radio AS T1 JOIN radio AS T2 ON T1.Radio_ID  =  T2.Radio_ID GROUP BY T2.Transmitter
fixed: SELECT r.transmitter, COUNT(distinct id) AS ChannelsCount FROM radio r LEFT JOIN city_channel_radio ccr ON r.radio_id = ccr.radio_id LEFT JOIN city_channel c ON c.id = ccr.city_channel_id GROUP BY r.radio_id
note: join -> left join; group by non-key

question: Show the distinct transmitters of radios that are not associated with any city channel.
original: SELECT Transmitter FROM radio WHERE Radio_ID NOT IN (SELECT Radio_ID FROM city_channel_radio)
fixed: SELECT DISTINCT transmitter FROM radio WHERE radio_id NOT IN (SELECT radio_id FROM city_channel_radio)

question: What is the model of the vehicle with maximum top speed whose power is higher than 6000?
original: SELECT model FROM vehicle WHERE power  >  6000 ORDER BY top_speed DESC LIMIT 1
fixed: SELECT model FROM vehicle WHERE power > 6000 AND top_speed = (SELECT MAX(top_speed) FROM vehicle WHERE power > 6000)

question: Of vehicles with power over 6000, return the model of the vehicle with the greatest top speed.
original: SELECT model FROM vehicle WHERE power  >  6000 ORDER BY top_speed DESC LIMIT 1
fixed: SELECT model FROM vehicle WHERE power > 6000 AND top_speed = (SELECT MAX(top_speed) FROM vehicle WHERE power > 6000)

question: How many vehicles has a driver driven at most, and what is the driver id of the driver who has driven this many vehicles?
original: SELECT count(*) ,  driver_id FROM vehicle_driver GROUP BY driver_id ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1
fixed: SELECT A.driver_id, A.num_vehicles FROM (SELECT driver_id, COUNT(vehicle_id) as num_vehicles FROM vehicle_driver GROUP BY driver_id) A WHERE A.num_vehicles = (SELECT MAX(num_vehicles) FROM (SELECT COUNT(vehicle_id) AS num_vehicles FROM vehicle_driver GROUP BY driver_id))

question: What is the id of the driver who has driven the most vehicles, and how many vehicles is this?
original: SELECT count(*) ,  driver_id FROM vehicle_driver GROUP BY driver_id ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1
fixed: SELECT A.driver_id, A.num_vehicles FROM (SELECT driver_id, COUNT(vehicle_id) as num_vehicles FROM vehicle_driver GROUP BY driver_id) A WHERE A.num_vehicles = (SELECT MAX(num_vehicles) FROM (SELECT COUNT(vehicle_id) AS num_vehicles FROM vehicle_driver GROUP BY driver_id))

question: What is the id of the vehicle driven for the least times for the vehicles ever used?
original: SELECT vehicle_id FROM vehicle_driver GROUP BY vehicle_id ORDER BY count(*) ASC LIMIT 1
fixed: SELECT vehicle_id FROM (SELECT vehicle_id, COUNT(driver_id) as frequency FROM vehicle_driver GROUP BY vehicle_id ORDER BY frequency ASC) WHERE frequency = (SELECT MIN(frequency) FROM (SELECT COUNT(driver_id) as frequency FROM vehicle_driver GROUP BY vehicle_id))

question: Return the id of the vehicle that has been driven the fewest times.
original: SELECT vehicle_id FROM vehicle_driver GROUP BY vehicle_id ORDER BY count(*) ASC LIMIT 1
fixed: SELECT vehicle_id FROM (SELECT vehicle_id, COUNT(driver_id) as frequency FROM vehicle_driver GROUP BY vehicle_id ORDER BY frequency ASC) WHERE frequency = (SELECT MIN(frequency) FROM (SELECT COUNT(driver_id) as frequency FROM vehicle_driver GROUP BY vehicle_id))

question: Return the names of drivers who have driven vehicles with power over 5000.
original: SELECT DISTINCT T1.Name FROM driver AS T1 JOIN vehicle_driver AS T2 ON T1.driver_id  =  T2.driver_id JOIN vehicle AS T3 ON T2.vehicle_id  =  T3.vehicle_id WHERE T3.power  >  5000
fixed: SELECT name FROM driver WHERE driver_id IN (SELECT driver_id FROM vehicle_driver WHERE vehicle_id IN (SELECT vehicle_id FROM vehicle WHERE power > 5000))

question: Which car models have total production larger than 100 or top speed higher than 150?
original: SELECT model FROM vehicle WHERE total_production  >  100 OR top_speed  >  150
fixed: SELECT DISTINCT v.model FROM vehicle v WHERE (v.total_production > 100 OR v.top_speed > 150);

question: Return the models of vehicles that have never been driven.
original: SELECT model FROM vehicle EXCEPT SELECT T1.model FROM vehicle AS T1 JOIN vehicle_driver AS T2 ON T1.vehicle_id  =  T2.vehicle_id
fixed: SELECT model FROM vehicle WHERE vehicle_id NOT IN (SELECT vehicle_id FROM vehicle_driver)

question: What are the vehicle ids and models of the vehicle which have been driven by two drivers or been manufactured by 'Ziyang'.
original: SELECT T1.vehicle_id ,  T1.model FROM vehicle AS T1 JOIN vehicle_driver AS T2 ON T1.vehicle_id  =  T2.vehicle_id GROUP BY T2.vehicle_id HAVING count(*)  =  2 OR T1.builder  =  'Ziyang'
fixed: SELECT DISTINCT v.vehicle_id, v.model FROM vehicle v WHERE v.builder = 'Ziyang' OR v.vehicle_id IN (SELECT vd.vehicle_id FROM vehicle_driver vd GROUP BY vd.vehicle_id HAVING COUNT(vd.driver_id) = 2)

question: Return the ids and models of vehicles that have been driven by exactly two drivers or built by Ziyang.
original: SELECT T1.vehicle_id ,  T1.model FROM vehicle AS T1 JOIN vehicle_driver AS T2 ON T1.vehicle_id  =  T2.vehicle_id GROUP BY T2.vehicle_id HAVING count(*)  =  2 OR T1.builder  =  'Ziyang'
fixed: SELECT DISTINCT v.vehicle_id, v.model FROM vehicle v WHERE v.builder = 'Ziyang' OR v.vehicle_id IN (SELECT vd.vehicle_id FROM vehicle_driver vd GROUP BY vd.vehicle_id HAVING COUNT(vd.driver_id) = 2)

question: What are the name and citizenship of the drivers who have driven the vehicle model 'DJ1'?
original: SELECT T1.name ,  T1.citizenship FROM driver AS T1 JOIN vehicle_driver AS T2 ON T1.driver_id  =  T2.driver_id JOIN vehicle AS T3 ON T2.vehicle_id  =  T3.vehicle_id WHERE T3.model  =  'DJ1'
fixed: SELECT name, citizenship FROM driver WHERE driver_id IN (SELECT driver_id FROM vehicle_driver WHERE vehicle_id IN (SELECT vehicle_id FROM vehicle WHERE model = 'DJ1'))

question: Return the names and citizenships of drivers who have driven the vehicle with the model 'DJ1'.
original: SELECT T1.name ,  T1.citizenship FROM driver AS T1 JOIN vehicle_driver AS T2 ON T1.driver_id  =  T2.driver_id JOIN vehicle AS T3 ON T2.vehicle_id  =  T3.vehicle_id WHERE T3.model  =  'DJ1'

question: Show the book title corresponding to the book with the most number of orders.

question: What is the venue with the least number of publications?

fixed: SELECT A.deathyear FROM artists A WHERE 3 >= (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM paintings WHERE painterid = A.artistid)

question: When did each artist who created less than 4 paintings die ?
original: select t1.deathyear from artists as t1 join paintings as t2 on t1.artistid  =  t2.painterid group by t2.painterid having count(*)  <  4
fixed: SELECT deathyear FROM artists WHERE (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM paintings WHERE painterid = artistid) < 4

question: Find the death year of the artist who made the least number of sculptures?
original: SELECT T1.deathYear FROM artists AS T1 JOIN sculptures AS T2 ON T1.artistID  =  T2.sculptorID GROUP BY T2.sculptorID ORDER BY count(*) LIMIT 1
fixed: WITH tmp as (SELECT A.deathYear, count(S.sculptureID) as cnt FROM Artists A LEFT JOIN Sculptures S on A.artistID = S.sculptorID GROUP BY A.artistID) SELECT tmp.deathYear FROM tmp WHERE cnt = (SELECT min(cnt) FROM tmp)

question: When did the artist who made the fewest sculptures die?
original: SELECT T1.deathYear FROM artists AS T1 JOIN sculptures AS T2 ON T1.artistID  =  T2.sculptorID GROUP BY T2.sculptorID ORDER BY count(*) LIMIT 1
fixed: WITH tmp as (SELECT A.deathYear, count(S.sculptureID) as cnt FROM Artists A LEFT JOIN Sculptures S on A.artistID = S.sculptorID GROUP BY A.artistID) SELECT tmp.deathYear FROM tmp WHERE cnt = (SELECT min(cnt) FROM tmp)

fixed: WITH DriverCounts AS ( SELECT t.team_id, COUNT(td.team_id) AS num_drivers FROM team t LEFT JOIN team_driver td ON t.team_id = td.team_id GROUP BY t.team_id ) SELECT t.manager, t.sponsor FROM team t INNER JOIN DriverCounts dc ON t.team_id = dc.team_id WHERE dc.num_drivers = ( SELECT MAX(num_drivers) FROM DriverCounts )
